# Fetch all pages of downloaded songs (page_limit=20)
all_downloaded = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_downloaded_songs(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_downloaded.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total downloaded songs: {len(all_downloaded)}")
print(all_downloaded)
